verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since an agent platform could reasonably offer one-click repository access. However, Omnara's docs only describe generic MCP server connections, YAML agent configs, and connecting machines; they never describe a one-click GitHub/repo install or repository grant flow. The only hint of a GitHub connect flow is a single community report of that OAuth connection failing with a redirect_uri error. With no vendor claim to set against it, that report cannot support either a delivered capability or a dispute.
